The legal issues presented in the paragraph revolve around the validity of the landlord's termination of the lease and the tenant's defense against eviction. Specifically, the case hinges on whether the landlord provided sufficient evidence to substantiate the allegation that the tenant conducted illegal activities within the premises. This raises questions regarding the burden of proof and the standard of evidence required to justify an eviction for cause. Additionally, the tenant's argument that the eviction was without just cause implicates statutory tenant protections, requiring an analysis of whether the landlord complied with applicable tenant laws and procedural requirements for lawful termination.
